title: Moud
description: The mod for the TypeScript-first Minecraft scripting framework
body:
# Moud 

Moud lets you write **server logic**, **client modifications**, and **graphics code** all in **TypeScript**, powered by **Minestom**, **Fabric**, and **GraalVM**.

---

## Features

**TypeScript scripting** – Write both server and client logic

**State Sync** – Shared values keep everything in sync automatically

**Custom Rendering** – Integrate shaders and post-processing

**Component UI System** – Create in-game interfaces

**High Performance** – GraalVM-powered TypeScript execution

**Modular** – Works with Minestom (server) and Fabric(client)
